records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:22311f92, email:4b99fea1) or tickets. Silent, fully unengaged admin with 8 days left; low odds of self-serve activation despite active Pro plan.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Following up on my note last week — no reply needed, but I want to make sure North Labs gets value quickly.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating the first project is usually the best starting point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that's unclear.

Best,
Nadia
